name: LaunchChair
tagline: LaunchChair turns messy product ideas into market-informed MVPs, then helps founders move from strategy to build to launch in one connected workflow
description: LaunchChair turns messy product ideas into market-informed MVPs, then helps founders move from strategy to build to launch in one connected workflow. Instead of starting with a blank doc or vague AI prompt, LaunchChair guides you through the product decisions that shape a stronger build: * Target user * Customer pain * Market wedge * Positioning * MVP scope That thinking becomes a living product spec. From there, LaunchChair generates structured, feature-by-feature prompts for the AI model or co
